title: Tikkit · Database & runtime
description: Repository latency, BEAM gauges and pipeline sample age by service instance; native cAdvisor CPU, throttling and memory by container identity. PostgreSQL internals, restarts and OOM metrics are not collected.

options.content:
**Selectors:** Service instance filters repository/BEAM panels only; Container filters cAdvisor panels only. They are independent identities and are not joined. All metric panels filter service and environment. Container series retain Docker name and cgroup-path container_id; collector instance identifies a node, not a BEAM service_instance_id. Container service_name comes from Docker service.name, then Swarm service, then Docker name. Container deployment_environment comes ONLY from the task container Docker label deployment.environment.name, not BEAM telemetry. Unlabelled containers appear only under Environment = All, never a named environment. Configure service.name and deployment.environment.name on task containers, not only Swarm service metadata. Repository telemetry measures application-side DB activity, not PostgreSQL internals. No traffic means undefined latency, not zero; sparse histograms make p95 noisy. Query and queue p95 are independent distributions and must not be added.

**Collection gaps:** PostgreSQL internals (locks, connections, disk), container restarts and OOM metrics remain unavailable; these panels do not infer them. Native cAdvisor CPU and memory panels below show observed usage and positive configured CFS/memory limits only. Unlimited or absent limits produce no limit/utilization series; throttling metrics may be absent without a quota. CPU quota is not CPU shares or cpuset capacity. BEAM memory is allocated memory, not container RSS. VM metrics with a `_ratio` suffix are counts, not percentages. Run queue total includes its components and is not stacked.

**Pipeline caveats:** Sample age uses the Prometheus sample timestamp, which may reflect collector re-emission rather than an application heartbeat. An absent series is not a healthy zero. The known bridge-only restart gauge recovery issue requires a BEAM/container restart; this dashboard adds no workaround.

**Deployments:** Markers tagged `tikkit-deployment` are shared across environments, not filtered by the environment selector. Publish manually or externally with environment and version in annotation text. No automated deployment integration is provided. Related logs below are service/environment-wide: neither the Service instance nor Container selector filters them.

panels.title: DB query / queue p95 · per instance
panels.description: Independent query and queue distributions in milliseconds. Do not add these quantiles. No observations yield undefined latency, not zero.

panels.title: DB total p95 · per instance
panels.description: p95 of the repository total-time histogram, not a sum of query/queue p95. Application-side timing; no observations means undefined latency.

panels.title: DB queries / second · per instance
panels.description: Rate of repository query-time histogram observations. Application repository throughput, not total PostgreSQL server throughput. Missing telemetry is not filled with zero.

panels.title: BEAM memory · bytes per instance
panels.description: BEAM allocated memory per environment and instance. Not container RSS or a memory-limit utilization percentage.

panels.title: BEAM processes · count per instance
panels.description: Process counts per environment and instance. The upstream _ratio suffix is a translation artifact: counts, not percentages.

panels.title: BEAM CPU / I/O / total run queues · per instance
panels.description: Queue lengths are counts despite _ratio suffixes, not CPU utilization. Total includes CPU and I/O components; series are deliberately not stacked.

panels.title: Pipeline metric sample age · seconds per instance
panels.description: Age of the latest vm_memory_total_bytes sample per environment and instance (maximum age if multiple series exist). This may reflect collector re-emission, not an application heartbeat. Missing/stale series disappear after Prometheus lookback; absence is not zero or proof of health.

panels.title: Related service / environment logs · NOT instance-filtered
panels.description: Newest 100 related service/environment logs. Neither the Service instance nor Container selector filters these lines; they are not guaranteed to belong to a selected instance or container.

panels.title: Native container resources · independent of BEAM Service instance
Container CPU · used / configured quota cores
panels.description: CPU seconds/second = used cores. Positive CFS quota/period = configured cores, not CPU shares or cpuset capacity. Unlimited or missing quota is omitted. Rates are calculated before aggregation; Docker name and cgroup path distinguish containers.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (container_spec_cpu_quota{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"} > 0) / sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (container_spec_cpu_period{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"} > 0)

panels.title: Container CPU · % of configured CFS quota
panels.description: Used cores × 100 / positive configured quota cores. No value for unlimited or absent quota; no clamping or zero fill. Numerator and denominator share identical grouping, removing the CPU label before division.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}",cpu="total"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (container_spec_cpu_quota{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"} > 0) / sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (container_spec_cpu_period{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"} > 0))

panels.title: Container CFS · throttled periods %
panels.description: Rate of throttled periods / positive rate of all CFS periods × 100. Fraction of periods experiencing throttling, not CPU usage percent. Metrics may be absent without a quota; zero period rate is omitted.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Container CFS · throttled seconds / second
panels.description: Rate of accumulated CFS throttled seconds, in seconds per second. Not equivalent to CPU utilization or throttled periods percent; do not multiply by 100. May be absent without a quota.

panels.title: Container memory · working set / usage / configured limit
panels.description: Native cgroup total usage and working set (usage minus inactive file cache), not BEAM allocations or RSS. Only positive configured memory limits are shown; observed unlimited limit 0 is omitted. These overlapping measurements are not stacked.

panels.title: Container memory · working set % of configured limit
panels.description: Working set × 100 / positive configured memory limit. Unlimited (0) or absent limits yield no percentage, not zero. Not BEAM memory utilization; no clamping.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"}) / sum by (deployment_environment, container, container_id) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{service_name="$service",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}",container=~"${container:regex}"} > 0)
